message: 親密に親睦会

name: Lolotte
message: 「I brought Mr. Octopus and Mr. Tuna」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa! It's a sashimi set」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Are your eyes just knotholes?!」

name: Misa
message: 「A whole tuna. Truly worthy of a young lady of the Rosenkreuz family」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I caught them at Tsukinoo Park, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Really……」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Forget it. There's nooo way you could catch that with your fishing rod」

name: Synn
message: 「I guess so……」

name: Ria
message: 「I wonder why the fish she caught are frozen rock solid, though」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku…… Pretty surprising for an angel to swipe goods from the market」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wha--?! Why are you spouting such wicked lies, Mr. Panda! I caught them fair and square. It's true!」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't think Lolotte would lie. It's gotta be true」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku…… Covering for an angel to put her deeply in your debt--truly worthy of Lord Synn」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Besides, I am not an angel! Hmph」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee. Pucky's all pitch black」

name: Misa
message: 「It's Blackuma. He turned into Blackuma……\s04」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What did you buy, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「I bought potatoes, carrots, onions, and chicken」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aaah, you don't get it! You just don't get it, Vice President!」

name: Misa
message: 「Wha--what's the matter」

name: Nanaka
message: 「This is where you're supposed to be adventurous, right, right?!」

name: Misa
message: 「E-Even if you say that to me...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Here, you should deliberately go with sweet potatoes, daikon, green onions, and horse meat!」

name: Misa
message: 「Those just have similar shapes and names...」

name: Synn
message: 「Dinner at Misa's place... Were you planning on making curry, by any chance?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yeah, so what... What's it to you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hehehe」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What!」

name: Synn
message: 「I love curry too!」

name: Misa
message: 「Then I hate it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What is this exchange」

name: Ria
message: 「Everything sounds so delicious~. I'm starting to look forward to it~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please tell us yours too, Senpai」

name: Ria
message: 「For me, it's cheese fondue, wine, and fish and chips」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa. Nothing but foreign words」

name: Synn
message: 「Ch-Cheese fondeju?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You didn't say it right」

name: Lolotte
message: 「W-Wine?! That's alcohol, right, my heart is racing」

name: Ria
message: 「You mustn't drink it as is. It's used for cooking, you know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Fish and chips means fish tempura and french fries, right」

name: Misa
message: 「I feel like it's a bit different from tempura, though...」

name: Ria
message: 「The way it's made is pretty similar, though it seems various things go into the batter. Like beer, depending on the recipe」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Beer!」

name: Synn
message: 「You've been really sensitive to alcohol this whole time」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, I'm normally not allowed to drink it. Isn't it only natural to wonder what it tastes like~」

name: Misa
message: 「No, you can't drink that. Wait until you're a little bigger.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Would being as big as you are be enough, Senpai?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, hey, where are you looking when you say that?」

name: Ria
message: 「G-Geez...\s03」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Anyway, everything here is so unusual--it all looks super delicious!」

name: Misa
message: 「Still... we're putting all of this into a hot pot, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Ria
message: 「It's really starting to feel like a proper mystery hot pot now\s02」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hold on, hold on! Aren't you forgetting something!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Your ingredient, Nanaka? Isn't it soba noodles?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Non, non. This is why amateurs are hopeless.」

name: Synn
message: 「What kind of pro are you supposed to be?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What I brought is sobagaki! Sobagaki!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why's the reaction so lukewarm!? After I racked my brain so hard to come up with it...」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't sweat it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Forget it! I'm gonna eat! I'm gonna stuff myself silly!」

name: Paqy
message: 「I doubt it's gonna turn out tasty, though.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm super excited for it~」
